summary.text: Erica Gillum is the Democratic candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Lois Kolkhorst.
She is a real estate agent and a former mayor of Hempstead.

paragraphs.text: Erica Gillum graduated from Hempstead High School and attended Prairie View A&M University.

Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent, and in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a Realtor, real estate coach, investor and developer with more than two decades of experience.
She said she served on the Hempstead City Council from 2020 to 2022 and as mayor of Hempstead from 2022 to 2024.
Gillum advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 18.

In her survey, she said her key messages include fully funding neighborhood schools and paying teachers more, along with creating jobs, supporting small businesses and offering workforce training for young adults.
